kyoto_tawaraya_ryokan.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Kyoto kaiseki dinners and Japanese or Western breakfasts; no gluten information (2023–26 reviews).
kyoto_tawaraya_ryokan.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: kaiseki of fish such as sea bream and ayu, duck hot pot and dashi; no vegan or vegetarian information in the sources (2023–26 reviews).
kyoto_tawaraya_ryokan.hours_raw: A ryokan: check-in 15:00, check-out 11:00; open all year (Tabelog). Dinner from 18:30 and breakfast from 8:00, Japanese or Western, served in the guest room (June 2026 review). The sources found describe meals only as part of a stay; no source shows meals for non-guests. Bento can be ordered ahead or on the day of a stay, but not collected on Tuesdays; no corkage on brought wine or drinks (Tabelog). Book by phone 075-211-5566 or through travel agents (Tabelog; September 2023). Rooms with tatami and sunken seating; Tabelog lists smoking as allowed; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). On Fuyacho north of Aneyakoji, across the street from Hiiragiya; 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; June 2026).
kyoto_tawaraya_ryokan.notes: [Ryokan kaiseki · Fuyacho, a grand old Kyoto inn] One of Kyoto's most famous inns, across the street from Hiiragiya, with garden views and art in every room. Its kaiseki dinners and celebrated breakfasts (charcoal-warmed yudofu) come with a stay, roughly ¥60,000–100,000+ a head; we found no source for dining without staying. Reviews are split: some call the food exceptional, others average.

roles: Cook named by a March 2026 reviewer
chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a long-established inn dating to the Edo period (May 2025), often called one of Kyoto's three great ryokan (2023–24 reviews); scrolls and ornaments in the rooms, with a list explaining them (April 2023).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto kaiseki; breakfast yudofu.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 regular wrote it is "worth coming here just to enjoy Mr. Kurokawa's cooking", but that the atmosphere had changed since skilled staff left.
A December 2023 guest found the food below expectations — the rice and dashi raised questions, and the breakfast fish was too dry to finish.
A January 2024 guest, waitlisted since early the previous year, got a 3 January slot for the New Year osechi, with the guest's own name on the chopstick wrappers.

cultural_comfort.note: Meals come with a stay; book the room by phone or through an agent.

kyoto_gosho_higashi_unashige.gf_detail: Ask. Eel under a soy-based sauce on rice, eel chawanmushi, uzaku; no gluten information (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_gosho_higashi_unashige.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed Sunday and Monday (Tabelog). Booking preferably through Instagram (Tabelog). The eel is steamed after you order, so expect about 30 minutes; a November 2025 reviewer suggests phoning the order ahead. Cards and QR payments, no e-money; non-smoking (Tabelog). 7 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_gosho_higashi_unashige.notes: [Unagi · east of the Imperial Palace] A calm machiya-style room where eel is cooked Kanto-style — steamed then grilled at the counter, soft and fluffy, with a restrained sauce. Unaju from about ¥5,200; the eel chawanmushi has fans. Each eel is steamed to order, so allow 30 minutes or phone ahead. Closed Sunday and Monday.

roles: Chef (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 March 2022 (Tabelog). A September 2026 reviewer writes that the chef trained for many years at "Unakiku" before opening here.
chef_bio.specialty: Kanto-style unaju; eel chawanmushi.

anecdotes.text: A sixth-time visitor in April 2025 singled out the eel chawanmushi — pricey on its own, but "that good".
An October 2026 regular found upbeat rock playing, lighter than usual, and trusted the 30-minute wait for eel steamed to order.
A July 2025 visitor who usually eats unaju in Nihonbashi called this a new favourite.

cultural_comfort.note: Book via Instagram; allow 30 minutes for the eel.

kyoto_orale_mexican_shijo.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and a vegetable focus; reviewed fillings are pork, chicken, beef, shrimp, and bean with cheese (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_orale_mexican_shijo.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:30), dinner 17:00–20:30 (L.O. 19:50); closed Monday; lunch may end early when the tortillas run out; temporary closures posted on Google and Instagram (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; busy at weekend lunch (Tabelog; March 2026). No service charge (Tabelog, original text). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 16 seats: 6 at the counter, 10 at tables, plus a terrace (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Children welcome; takeaway and delivery via Demae-can, Uber Eats and Foodpanda (Tabelog). Near Nishiki, north from Shijo Stn exit 14 up Sakaimachi (Tabelog; April 2026). Opened 5 November 2014 (Tabelog).
kyoto_orale_mexican_shijo.notes: [Mexican · Shijo-Sakaimachi, handmade corn tortillas] A small, cheerfully decorated Mexican restaurant up Sakaimachi from Shijo, around since 2014, where the corn tortillas are made and grilled by hand. Lunch sets come with a soup — the Tres Tacos with three heavily filled tacos was ¥2,700 in 2025 — and there are burritos, quesadillas, enchiladas and mole, plus tequila and Mexican beer. Portions are large; leftovers can be packed. Lunch can end early when the tortillas run out. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 5 November 2014. An April 2026 reviewer admired the female owner’s creative ideas and presentation.
chef_bio.specialty: Tacos on handmade corn tortillas.

kyoto_kopan_kushiage_pontocho.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a kushiage restaurant — every skewer is breaded and deep-fried (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_kopan_kushiage_pontocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: skewers include beef fillet, braised pork, salmon and duck, fried in batter (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kopan_kushiage_pontocho.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00, last entry 21:00, Monday and Thursday–Sunday; closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted for the omakase course; same-day cancellations by phone (Tabelog). Seat charge ¥550 including a vegetable platter and dessert (Tabelog). Cards: VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX; e-money; no QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: 10 at the counter and tables (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog). Kiyamachi south of Sanjo, 3 min from Keihan Sanjo exit 6 (Tabelog). Opened 30 July 2004 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kopan_kushiage_pontocho.notes: [Kushiage · Kiyamachi-Sanjo, omakase skewers with wine] A stylish counter just south of Sanjo where kushiage are fried one at a time and brought hot until you say stop — 12 skewers for ¥4,620 or 16 for ¥6,160, with a beef fillet skewer as an extra. The skewers change monthly (yuba, braised pork, truffle) and pair with a fair-priced wine list, to jazz in the background. ¥550 seat charge brings a vegetable platter and dessert. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Run by the Safari group (Osaka); a woman reviewers took to be the owner runs the floor
chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 30 July 2004. The Safari group site lists ワインと串揚げ こぱん with shops in Naha and Pontocho, among the group’s 13 concepts in Kansai and Seattle.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase kushiage; beef fillet skewer.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 regular asked to skip a few skewers so as to reach the end of the course, and was given braised pork and others not tried before.
A March 2026 diner named a cucumber allergy, yet was served vegetable sticks with cucumber.
A May 2026 diner found the skewers arrived faster than a drinker could keep up with, and the plate overflowed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ワインと串揚げ こぱん 先斗町店、串揚げ・居酒屋・ワインバー、中京区木屋町三条下ル材木町180-1 1F、京阪三条駅6番出口から徒歩3分、月・木〜日 17:00〜22:00 (最終入店21:00)、火・水休み、予約可、おまかせ12本4,620円、16本6,160円、特選牛フィレ串は1本638円追加、席料550円 (野菜盛り合わせ・デザート付き)、カード・電子マネー可、20席、禁煙、子ども可、2004年7月30日オープン。サファリグループのサイト: 創作串あげ専門店、京の食材、ソムリエが選ぶワイン、那覇店と先斗町店。口コミ (2026年、英語): 毎月替わる串、湯葉、豚の角煮、トリュフ、ジャズ、ワインが手ごろ。

kyoto_uogashi_miyatake.gf_detail: Ask. Fish courses of sashimi, grills, simmered dishes and sushi, including tempura and fried cod, which are not gluten-free (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_uogashi_miyatake.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish courses with dashi soups (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_uogashi_miyatake.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:00, drinks 22:30), Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday and holidays; no lunch at present (Tabelog; official site). Reservations by phone 14:00–22:00 (official site); Tabelog: phone bookings for 1–2 guests (seats only), courses booked online for 3 or more. Evenings are course-based (December 2025; September 2026). Cards, IC cards and QR accepted (Tabelog). 34 seats: 10 at the counter, 24 in a sunken-hearth tatami room for 2–24 (Tabelog; official site). Non-smoking; wheelchair access (Tabelog). Junior-high age and up only (Tabelog). In Shimabara next to the Kyoto Central Wholesale Market, 3 min from JR Tambaguchi Stn; no sign outside (official site). Opened 1 October 2012 (Tabelog).
kyoto_uogashi_miyatake.notes: [Fish izakaya · Shimabara, the market’s back door] An unsigned izakaya in old Shimabara beside Kyoto’s Central Wholesale Market, where the cooks work at a counter level with your plate and the fish comes from a trusted market wholesaler. Evenings are courses — ¥6,000 or ¥9,900 — that change completely between visits: rare sashimi such as akou and ojisan, shio-koji yellowtail, simmered kinmedai head, cod fry, omakase sushi. Lunch has stopped for now. Closed Sunday and holidays; junior-high age and up.

roles: Kitchen team (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: opened in Shimabara next to the Kyoto Central Wholesale Market as a sign-less open-kitchen izakaya, buying through the market wholesaler 河市水産. Tabelog gives the opening as 1 October 2012. December 2025 and September 2026 reviewers note the popular lunch has stopped and evenings run on courses.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal fish close to ryotei standard at izakaya prices, served in the spirit of ichigo ichie (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal fish courses; omakase sushi.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor booked a hotel five or six minutes away purely to eat here, and phoned to book the ¥6,000 course.
An August 2026 regular had the same ¥6,000 course twice and found the dishes completely different, opening with sashimi of akou and ojisan.
A February 2026 visitor stopped in after training at the Kyoto Railway Museum.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 魚河岸 宮武、京都中央卸売市場に隣接する島原の看板のない大人の隠れ家、オープンキッチンの居酒屋、「料亭クラスに限りなく近い旬の魚料理を居酒屋として」、カウンターとまな板を同じ高さに、17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、日曜・祝日休み、予約は電話 (14:00〜22:00)、カウンター10席、座敷24席、主要仕入先 河市水産、JR丹波口駅から徒歩3分。食べログ: 下京区西新屋敷下之町6-5 アンクル島原1F、昼の営業は休止中、カード・電子マネー・QR可、禁煙、車椅子可、中学生以上、2012年10月1日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 6,000円と9,900円のコース、あこう、おじさん、ぶりの塩麹焼き、金目鯛のかぶと煮、鱈フライ、おまかせ握り、締め鯖。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone (courses online for 3 or more); no sign outside; junior-high age and up.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_marutamachi_junidanya.gf_detail: Ask. Ochazuke sets of rice, pickles, dashimaki and red-miso soup; the pickles and miso are not described for gluten (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_marutamachi_junidanya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashimaki of egg and bonito-kombu dashi in every set; some sets add fish (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_marutamachi_junidanya.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 13:30), dinner 17:00–19:00 (L.O. 18:30); closed Wednesday and over New Year; open until sold out; other irregular closures, posted on the site — closed on 6 November 2026 (official site; Tabelog). No reservations (official site), except the second-floor shabu-shabu rooms, whose bookings resumed in September 2026 (official site notice). Queues in autumn — nearly an hour for the second seating in November 2026. Cards and e-money accepted; Apple Pay; no QR (Tabelog). 22 seats on the first floor at tables and low round tables; Tabelog notes only the first floor open with a limited menu (Tabelog). Non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). On Marutamachi west of Karasuma, at the southwest corner of the Imperial Palace grounds, 2 min from Marutamachi Stn exit 4 (official site).
kyoto_marutamachi_junidanya.notes: [Ochazuke · Marutamachi, Kyoto’s everyday meal since the Taisho era] An old machiya by the Imperial Palace serving “ochazuke” in the Kyoto sense — a modest meal. The Suzushiro set (¥1,500, lunch or dinner) brings a feather-light rolled omelette made with a dashi started at 4 a.m., red-miso soup, a tub of rice and seasonal pickles, with Ippodo hojicha for the ochazuke. No reservations and queues in autumn; dinner ends early, at 19:00. Staff greet in soft Kyoto dialect and speak English. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Family business (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: an ochazuke house in business since the Taisho era. It began as a sweets shop in Gion named Junidanya after the twelve acts of Chushingura; ochazuke served to settle the palates of tipsy customers proved so popular that it has continued ever since. The site lists TV and press coverage and a 2025 article recalling 長嶋茂雄 as a patron.
chef_bio.philosophy: Ochazuke as Kyoto cuisine in everyday dress — plain food that cannot hide anything; local and contract-farm vegetables, Ippodo tea (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Dashimaki; the Suzushiro ochazuke set.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 sightseer sent by a taxi driver got a table straight away, and on leaving was waved off by the kitchen staff with "Enjoy your trip in Kyoto!"
A November 2026 visitor arrived five minutes before opening, still landed in the second seating, and waited nearly an hour — good food, not worth that wait.
A September 2026 regular noticed many visitors from abroad and staff who spoke fluent English.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 丸太町十二段家、中京区常真横町184-3 (丸太町通両替町西入)、大正から続くお茶漬けの老舗、もとは祇園町の甘党屋で歌舞伎の忠臣蔵十二段にちなむ屋号、酔客の口直しのお茶漬けが始まり、元祖お茶漬け、すずしろ (だし巻き、赤だし、ご飯、季節のお漬物盛り合わせ)、枕崎の鰹本節と利尻昆布の一番だしのだし巻き、毎朝4時から出汁、契約農家と地元の野菜、一保堂のほうじ茶、涮牛肉と和牛ステーキ、昼11:30〜14:00、夜17:00〜19:00、水曜休み、予約不可、2026年11月6日は臨時休業、しゃぶしゃぶ2階個室の予約再開 (2026年9月)。食べログ: 22席、カード・電子マネー可、禁煙、子ども可、現在は1階のみで品数を限定。口コミ (2026年、英語): すずしろ1,500円、ふわふわのだし巻き、京言葉の接客、英語を話すスタッフ、秋は行列。

cultural_comfort.note: English-speaking staff (September 2026); no reservations, queue in busy seasons.

existence.note: Official site (notices through 5 November 2026); Tabelog reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_taku_sando_sanjo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: every sandwich is on house shokupan milk bread, and the katsu and croquettes are coated in panko (Sanjo menu).
kyoto_taku_sando_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the two vegetarian sandwiches (potato croquette, egg salad) still use milk bread and karashi-mustard mayo; the fries carry a fish-and-vegetable dashi furikake (Sanjo menu). Shiso edamame is marked vegetarian — ask.
kyoto_taku_sando_sanjo.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 12:00–17:00 (food L.O. 16:30); schedule changes are posted on Google Maps. Tabelog says reservations are not taken, but a December 2025 diner booked ahead and a January 2026 diner booked through Tabelog; a February 2026 diner found the counter filling up at 1 pm on a Saturday and suggests booking at weekends. 12 counter seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; take-out; English menu and English-speaking staff; children welcome with a kids menu (Tabelog). Opened 15 October 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_taku_sando_sanjo.notes: [Sandwiches · downtown, Brooklyn katsu sando with sake] A twelve-seat counter south of Sanjo, the Kyoto outpost of a Brooklyn sando shop ("HELLO, Kyoto! WE ARE FROM BROOKLYN"), with a second Kyoto shop at Kiyomizu. Freshly fried pork or chicken katsu with cabbage and house sauce on milk bread, ¥1,500; egg-salad sando ¥1,300; beef fillet katsu ¥4,000. Portions are big — several diners took half home — and one found the sauce about to spill out. Sake picked by the owner-sommelier. English menu and staff; many overseas customers. Daily 12:00–17:00.

chef_bio.chef_name: Sakaki Nakamura (owner and sommelier, per the Sanjo menu; name known only in Latin letters)
roles: Owner and sake sommelier (Sanjo menu: "Sakaki Nakamura, the owner/sommelier, curates fine sake from all over Japan")
chef_bio.background: Taku Sando began in Greenpoint, Brooklyn (29 Greenpoint Ave), "brought to you by the creative team of Takumen in LIC", around a shokupan milk bread baked in-house daily (takusando.com About page). The Kyoto site lists two Kyoto shops, Sanjo and Kiyomizu, beside Brooklyn; the Sanjo menu is headed "HELLO, Kyoto! WE ARE FROM BROOKLYN." The Sanjo shop opened on 15 October 2024 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: From the Brooklyn About page: the shokupan "represents a wholesome luxury, and is the heart of the meal".
chef_bio.specialty: Pork katsu sando; chicken katsu sando; tamago sando.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 diner who does not like thigh meat asked for chicken katsu of breast only, and a friend switched to all thigh; the staff obliged.
"The sandwich was packed with tonkatsu and cabbage, and the sauce was about to spill out." — April 2026; the diner ate half and took the rest away.
An August 2025 diner found all the other customers were from overseas.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (takusandokyoto.com): Taku Sando Kyoto、京都の店舗は Sanjo (海老屋町327) と Kiyomizu (英語表記 4 Chome-148-3 Kiyomizu)、ほかにブルックリン店。三条のメニュー (英語 PDF): Ton-Katsu Sando 1,500円、Chicken-Katsu Sando 1,500円 (むねともも)、Classic Korokke Sando 1,300円 (ベジタリアン)、Tamago Sando 1,300円 (ベジタリアン)、Japanese Beef Fillet Katsu Sando 4,000円、Matcha Strawberry Sando 850円、Kids Sando 900円、Dashi Fries 600円 (魚と野菜のだしのふりかけ)、Shiso Edamame 700円 (ベジタリアン)、日本酒グラス100ml 900円、オーナー兼ソムリエ Sakaki Nakamura が全国の日本酒を選ぶ、"HELLO, Kyoto ! WE ARE FROM BROOKLYN"。ブルックリン店のサイト: Takumen (LIC) のチームによる店、毎日店で焼く食パンが主役。食べログ: サンドイッチ・日本酒バー、中京区御幸町通三条下ル海老屋町327、毎日12:00〜17:00 (L.O. 16:30)、予約不可、カウンター12席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可、テイクアウト、英語メニュー・英語のスタッフ、子供メニュー、2024年10月15日オープン。口コミ (2024年10月〜2026年4月、英語): 卵サンド、揚げたてのカツ、量が多く半分持ち帰り、客は海外からの人が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); take-out available.

existence.note: Official Kyoto site lists the Sanjo shop; Tabelog reviews dated through April 2026.

kyoto_hide_tako.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: takoyaki are wheat-batter balls; sauces include Worcester-style sauce, soy and demi-glace (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_hide_tako.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every takoyaki holds octopus, with mayonnaise and cheese toppings (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_hide_tako.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 18:00–04:00 (L.O. 03:30); Sun and holidays 18:00–03:00 (L.O. 02:30); irregular closing days. No reservations. 13 counter seats; smoking allowed (Tabelog). No cards or QR; e-money accepted (Tabelog). Take-out (Tabelog). Toppings such as green onion and mayonnaise cost extra (November 2025).
kyoto_hide_tako.notes: [Takoyaki · Gion, until 4 am] A thirteen-seat L-shaped counter under red lanterns on the ground floor of a club building on Hanamikoji, frying takoyaki till 4 am; diners say it has been there 20 years, with a second-generation owner greeting passers-by. Eight crisp-shelled, gooey balls for ¥800 in seventeen flavours — sauce, salt, pizza, seaweed kimchi — plus half-and-half; champagne and sake beside the beer. One diner found the beer glass small; another felt chilly in the half-open room in autumn and a little intimidated by the street at night. Smoking allowed. Cash or e-money.

roles: Second-generation owner (January 2026 review); not named in a source
chef_bio.background: The shop blog (ameblo, last updated 2012) calls 秀蛸 a takoyaki shop born in Kyoto, with a Gion main shop and a Kiyamachi shop; a February 2012 post mentions staff from all three shops of the time. Tabelog lists the Gion shop and a Kiyamachi shop today. A June 2025 diner and a January 2026 diner say it has been running for 20 years; the January 2026 diner calls the energetic young owner the second generation.
chef_bio.specialty: Takoyaki in many sauces, with half-and-half plates.

anecdotes.text: "The energetic young owner, the second generation, has been running this place for 20 years, and it shows in the warm greetings exchanged with passersby." — January 2026.
A couple staying nearby came past 10 pm when hunger struck and were squeezed in at the busy counter (April 2026).
"The beer was served in a small glass and I finished it quickly." — April 2026; the beef tendon stew was the highlight.
A November 2025 diner found the half-open room chilly on an autumn night, and the street, lined with clubs, a little intimidating.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 店のブログ (ameblo、2012年まで更新): 祗園「秀蛸」、京都生まれのたこ焼き屋、祇園本店と木屋町店、2012年2月の記事に「秀蛸３店舗の全メンバー」。食べログ: たこ焼き、東山区清本町353-1 花見小路ビル1F、祇園四条駅から310m、月〜土 18:00〜翌4:00 (L.O. 3:30)、日・祝 18:00〜翌3:00 (L.O. 2:30)、不定休、予約不可、13席、喫煙可、カード・QR不可、電子マネー可、テイクアウト。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年6月、英語): 8個800円で17種類、ハーフ&ハーフ+50円、ソース・塩・ピザ・デミグラス・海苔キムチ・ねぎとわさび、牛すじ煮込み、砂肝、日本酒とシャンパン、20年続く店、2代目の若い店主、外のような席で秋の夜は寒い、ビールのグラスが小さい。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk-in counter; point at the flavour list; friendly staff (2025–2026 reviews).

kyoto_matakichi_gion.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information: dinner is pasta, bruschetta and a veal cutlet beside carpaccio and charcoal-grilled meat; lunch sets are simmered fish or teriyaki wagyu with miso soup (official menu). Course changes for allergies must be phoned in ahead, not on the day (Tabelog).
kyoto_matakichi_gion.vegan_detail: Ask. Lunch sets and dinner dishes use fish, beef, pork or cheese (official menu); the shaved-ice syrups are fruit, matcha or brown sugar, with condensed milk as an extra topping.
kyoto_matakichi_gion.hours_raw: Official site: lunch 12:00–16:00 (drinks and shaved ice only after 14:00; lunch 12:00–14:00, shaved ice 12:00–16:00), dinner 17:00–21:00, irregular closing days; reservations by phone. Tabelog lists 12:00–15:00 and 17:30–21:00. Official site: counter of 7 and tables for 5 and 2; cards and QR (PayPay, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, d Barai, Merpay, Alipay, WeChat Pay), cash not accepted. Tabelog: 19 seats (8 counter, 11 table), a private room for 4; children 13 and up; non-smoking; course allergy changes by phone in advance only. Dinner prices exclude 10% tax (official menu).
kyoto_matakichi_gion.notes: [Italian & shaved ice · Gion south, Matayoshi's casual sister] The casual sister of Gion Matayoshi, also on the south side of Gion, behind a patterned block lattice: by day a fish or wagyu lunch tray and natural-ice kakigori with house syrups, by night Italian à la carte on kaiseki plates — sea-urchin aglio e olio, wagyu Bolognese, veal cutlet. Diners in 2025–2026 praised sea-bream chazuke, rich matcha ice and warm send-offs; others found a ¥1,800 matcha ice average (July 2026), slow drinks with two staff (July 2026), and food average with uneven pacing and few drinks (October 2026). No cash.

roles: Sister shop of 祇園又吉 (official site); the chef is not named
chef_bio.background: The 祇園又吉 site announced the new shop また吉 on 1 August 2021; Tabelog reviews go back to January 2025. The また吉 site itself says it was born in October 2026, serving Italian with the same chosen ingredients and preparation as the main restaurant plus natural-ice shaved ice at casual prices; an August 2026 diner mentions a recent renovation, and an October 2026 diner calls it still new. A July 2026 diner writes that the owner hails from Okinawa. Natural ice from 四代目徳次郎 in Nikko (official site).
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「もっと軽い気持ちで、本物の味を楽しんで欲しい」 — "We want people to enjoy the real thing, with a lighter heart."
chef_bio.specialty: Natural-ice kakigori; Italian à la carte on Japanese tableware; lunch trays.

anecdotes.text: A diner brought an elderly mother for the chazuke lunch in June 2026 and found the staff kind and the meal comfortable for older guests.
"At JPY 1,800, it was on the expensive side, but both the quantity and flavor were just average." — matcha shaved ice, July 2026.
A September 2026 diner came only for a pineapple shaved ice, served with warm tea, and was seen off by several staff.
"Sometimes the dishes come out quickly, while at other times, they take an unusually long time." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: また吉の公式サイト (gion-matayoshi.com/matakichi): 祇園又吉がひらく気軽なもう一軒、「もっと軽い気持ちで、本物の味を楽しんで欲しい」、2026年10月に祇園町南側に生まれた、本店と同じ厳選食材や仕込みのイタリアンと天然氷のかき氷、花ブロックの格子が目印、祇園町南側570-120 万治ビル1階、昼12:00〜16:00 (14時からはドリンクとかき氷のみ)、夜17:00〜21:00、不定休、電話予約、カウンター7席・テーブル5名と2名、カードとバーコード決済のみで現金不可。メニュー: 魚御膳2,980円 (魚の炊いた物、鰊とおぼろ昆布、京のお揚げさんと京野菜の小鍋、牛汁 京白味噌仕立て、新潟村上産コシヒカリ、自家製浅漬け)、肉御膳5,000円 (石垣牛の照り焼き)、かき氷は日光・四代目徳次郎の天然氷 (究極の抹茶2,300円、濃厚いちご・石垣島のパイナップル・波照間黒糖蜜きな粉につぶあん1,500円、いちじく・木の芽・マンゴー2,000円、トッピング400円)、夜のアラカルト (塩水ウニのアーリオオーリオ3,500円、石垣牛のボロネーゼ2,500円、仔牛のカツレツ3,300円、石垣牛イチボの炭焼きタリアータ4,200円、抹茶ティラミス800円ほか、税別)。祇園又吉の公式サイト: 新店舗「また吉」開店のご案内 [2021.8.1]。食べログ: イタリアン・日本料理・かき氷、12:00〜15:00、17:30〜21:00、不定休、予約可、コースのアレルギー変更は事前に電話で、当日は不可、19席 (カウンター8、テーブル11)、個室4名、禁煙、13歳以上。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年10月、英語): 鯛茶漬けの御膳、女将のもてなし、店主は沖縄出身、昼のミニコース、6,000円のコース、抹茶かき氷1,800円は普通、抹茶が濃い、改装、パイナップルのかき氷1,500円、スタッフ2人でドリンクが遅れる、料理は普通で出るのにむらがあり、飲み物が少ない。

cultural_comfort.note: Bilingual Japanese/English website and menu; bookings by phone; diners walked in for shaved ice (2026 reviews).

existence.note: Official site (2026) and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_gion_moriwaki.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; courses end with the owner’s handmade 100% buckwheat soba (official site), served in a dashi-based kaiseki.
kyoto_gion_moriwaki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish kaiseki opening with freshly shaved bonito flakes, with sashimi, sweetfish, eel and dashi soups (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_moriwaki.hours_raw: Official site: lunch, entry at 12:00 (booking required); dinner, entry 18:00–19:00 (booking required); closed Thursday and Friday lunch, other days irregular. Tabelog gives the same: Mon–Wed, Sat, Sun 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–19:00; Fri 18:00–19:00; Thu closed — the times are entry times, not closing times. Cash only (official site; April 2026). Lunch courses ¥7,000–18,000, dinner ¥12,000/15,000/18,000, plus tax and 10% service (official site). Cancellation: 100% the day before or on the day, 80% two days before, 50% three days before (official site). 10 seats: 6 counter, one table for 4; babies welcome; non-smoking with a smoking spot outside (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_moriwaki.notes: [Kaiseki · Gion south, ten seats and handmade soba] A ten-seat kaiseki counter east of Hanamikoji, opened in 2014 and starred in the 2016 Michelin Guide (Tabelog). Courses start with a brown-rice soup and freshly shaved bonito, run through hamo, sweetfish and eel, and end with the owner’s own 100% buckwheat soba. An April 2026 couple found it rare for Gion: lightly seasoned, traditional Kyoto cooking from ¥12,000 at night, with the owners seeing them off. The site says no English is spoken — book through your hotel. Cash only. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.chef_name: Moriwaki (surname from the shop name; Tabelog gives a full name only in machine translation, so it is not used)
roles: Owner-chef (店主), per the official site
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a small ten-seat shop born in Gion in 2014, serving seasonal kaiseki that ends with the owner’s handmade 100% buckwheat soba. Tabelog (in its English translation): the chef trained at ryokans, sushi restaurants and other places, then at "Irifune" and "Gion Okada" before going independent; opened 28 August 2014; a Michelin star in the 2016 Michelin Guide, about a year after opening. A January 2025 diner was served by the head chef, the proprietress and another chef.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: to be a shop that always stays close by, for time alone or time with someone dear.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kaiseki; handmade 100% buckwheat soba to finish.

anecdotes.text: "I had the handmade 100% buckwheat soba prepared by the owner himself." — March 2025, a second visit.
An April 2026 couple, after finding most well-known Gion dinners near ¥30,000, chose the ¥18,000 course here and were seen off by the owners after the meal.
An eighth-time regular notes that payment is cash only; a card is taken at booking only for cancellations (April 2026).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gion-moriwaki.jp): 2014年に祇園町に10席だけの小さな店、四季折々の料理と店主の手打ち十割蕎麦を〆に会席料理、おひとりでの時間にも大切な方との時間にも寄り添える店、昼12時入店・夜18時〜19時入店 (要予約)、定休日は木曜日と金曜日の昼ほか不定休、祇園町南側570-177、昼7,000・9,000・12,000・15,000・18,000円、夜12,000・15,000・18,000円 (税別、サービス料10%)、支払いは現金、キャンセルは当日・前日100%・2日前80%・3日前50%、英語は話せないのでホテルのコンシェルジュから電話を、贈りもの (お土産)。食べログ: 日本料理、10席 (カウンター6、テーブル4名1卓)、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、夜のみサービス料10%、赤ちゃん可、2014年8月28日オープン、ミシュランガイド2016で一つ星 (食べログの紹介文)。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年10月): 玄米のスープから始まる、削りたての鰹節、雲丹と蟹の黄身酢、鮑、鱧と松茸、ぐじ、鮎、鰻、十割蕎麦で〆、大将と女将ともう一人の料理人、薄味の京料理、見送り。2026年6月の口コミ (日本語、9,000円の昼): 水無月豆腐とシマエビとウニ、鱧落としのお椀、焼いたびわ湖の鮎、鯛・本マグロ・ミルガイ・ケンサキのお造り。

kyoto_gion_tempura_bansan.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a tempura counter — every course centres on battered, fried tempura and a tempura rice ball (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_tempura_bansan.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses open with wagyu tail soup and run through prawn, fish, sea urchin and wagyu tempura (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_tempura_bansan.hours_raw: Dinner from 17:00 to 25:00 (last order 24:30) and lunch from 12:00, lunch by reservation made by the day before (official site). Tabelog gives lunch last entry 13:30 (reservation only, by the day before) and dinner last entry 21:00, courses only, booked by the day before; per the official site, à la carte is available after 21:00. Closed irregularly, sometimes without notice (Tabelog). Book ahead: 6 counter seats (Tabelog; official site; some reviewers counted about 8); private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Staff spoke fluent English with foreign guests (September 2025). On the 1st floor of キャッスルギオンビル on a corner in Tominagacho, off the main street; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; December 2025). Opened 21 March 2021 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_tempura_bansan.notes: [Tempura · Gion, a six-seat counter] A tiny tempura counter on a Gion corner, where one chef fries course after course in front of six guests. Dinner (¥7,700 or ¥12,100) starts with wagyu tail soup, sashimi and seared wagyu, then about ten seasonal pieces — kuruma prawn, aosa seaweed piled with sea urchin, Kamo eggplant, eel, young ayu in summer, a rare-fried wagyu — and ends with a tempura rice ball. Lunch from ¥3,300 is the value pick. Book by the day before. Run by the small Kyoto group 京色; reviewers like the quiet chef and the price for Gion.

roles: Head chef (not named) who runs the counter alone (June 2026); operator 株式会社京色
chef_bio.background: Per the operator site: 株式会社京色 was founded by its president 眞鍋 and the cooks 藤原 and 山内, who studied together at a cooking school and gained experience in Japanese, Western and creative cooking before reuniting; the company runs 5 Kyoto shops — うらやま京色, BANSAN 京色, 祇園 晩餐 京色, 祇園天ぷら晩餐 and 角打ちと麺 ばんさん. Per the official page: a counter of six seats, "the distance at which freshly fried tempura can be served without losing its taste." Opened 21 March 2021 (Tabelog). The chef told a July 2026 diner the oil is 100% cottonseed.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official page: tempura needs both fresh ingredients and the cook’s skill — no letting up from buying to the moment it is served.
chef_bio.specialty: Aosa tempura topped with sea urchin; wagyu tail soup; tempura rice ball.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 diner noted the head chef runs everything alone, keeping a comfortable distance without too much talk.
A March 2026 diner liked the yuzu-daikon palate cleanser so much as to ask for a second helping.
An April 2026 lunch guest found the tail soup tasty but small, and understandable for a ¥3,300 lunch.
A March 2026 diner found the space a bit cramped for groups of more than three.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyosyoku.com): 祇園天ぷら晩餐、京都祇園のカウンターのみの天ぷら専門店、カウンター6席は「揚げたての美味しさを逃さずお届けできる距離」、21:00以降はアラカルトも、旬の味覚をおひとり様ずつコースで、祇園の晩餐に12,100円コース (ランチ11,000円)、より気軽に7,700円コース (ランチ6,600円)、ランチ限定の天ぷら会席3,300円、ある日の例: 先付 テールスープ、本日の鮮魚の造り、国産黒毛和牛あぶり、天ぷら (車海老、茄子、雲丹、肉厚しいたけ、サワラゆず幽庵、コッペガニ、ウナギ、蛤、国産黒毛和牛、甘鯛)、天むす、赤出汁、デザート、東山区富永町112 キャッスルギオン、ディナー17時〜25時 (L.O. 24時30分)、ランチ12時〜 (前日迄の完全予約のみ)。株式会社京色: 社長 眞鍋、料理人 藤原・山内、食の専門学校で共に学ぶ、うらやま京色・BANSAN 京色・祇園 晩餐 京色・祇園天ぷら晩餐・角打ちと麺 ばんさん。食べログ: 天ぷら・居酒屋・日本料理、大和大路通四条上る富永町112 キャッスルギオンビル 1F、ランチ最終入店13:30、ディナー最終入店21:00 (コースのみ、前日までに予約)、不定休、6席 (カウンター)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、カード可、2021年3月21日オープン。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年10月、英語): 綿実油100%、英語が話せるスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff spoke fluent English with foreign guests (September 2025); book by the day before.

kyoto_gion_adachiya.gf_detail: Ask. An izakaya menu of miso pork soup, fried dishes, oden, Saikyo-miso fish and soy-seasoned plates; no gluten information is published (official menu; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_adachiya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the signature is pork miso soup, alongside horse sashimi, fish, fried chicken and oden; a few plates such as grilled shiitake or Tochio fried tofu with negi miso have no published ingredients (official menu; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_adachiya.hours_raw: 18:00–3:00 Monday to Saturday (last order 2:30); 17:00–24:00 on the day before a holiday (last order 23:30); closed Sunday, but open Sunday and closed Monday when Monday is a holiday (Tabelog; official site gives 18:00–3:00, closed Sunday). Cover charge ¥500 per person; bookings taken, with a 2-hour limit when busy (Tabelog). 18 seats: 8 at the counter and 2 tables, pairs usually at the counter; smoking allowed (Tabelog; official site; October 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Faces Kiritoshi in Gion, near Tatsumi Bridge; 4 min from Gion-Shijo Stn exit 7 (official site; Tabelog; April 2026). Opened 26 November 2013 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_adachiya.notes: [Izakaya · Gion, Niigata sake till 3 a.m.] A small, smoky, late-night izakaya on Gion's Kiritoshi, run by an owner from Niigata. It pours Niigata sake — ask for the off-menu bottles — with a long list of homey plates: tuna macaroni salad, nikujaga, horse sashimi, giant Tochio fried tofu with negi miso, oden in winter, and the namesake pork miso soup to finish. Mostly locals, Showa pop on the speakers, ¥500 cover. Open until 3:00; closed Sunday.

roles: Owner, 大将 (the invoice holder; from Niigata)
chef_bio.background: The invoice register lists an individual, 安達 秀行, for the shop’s invoice number; the official site links the Instagram account adachihideyuki. Per the official site: a slightly hidden shop facing Kiritoshi in Gion, with sake and local dishes from the 大将’s home prefecture of Niigata alongside popular modern dishes. Reviewers describe an owner from Niigata (June and October 2025) and a master who sometimes drinks along with guests (April 2025). Opened 26 November 2013 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "空間、人、美味しさ" — the space, the people and good food; at-home and hidden at once.
chef_bio.specialty: Pork miso soup; Tochio fried tofu with negi miso; Niigata sake.

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 guest ended up drinking with the tipsy master, with Showa pop on the speakers turning into a DJ session.
A June 2025 pair found the atmosphere between the chef and the owner a bit off, which made it hard to relax.
A January 2026 guest found the service from staff other than the owner lacking.
An April 2026 diner asked the owner for off-menu Niigata sake and liked the Sasashiki.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gion-adachiya.com): ぎをんの豚汁屋さん あだち家、和風居酒屋、京都祇園の切通しに面する隠れ家、大将の故郷新潟県の地酒、郷土料理、東山区清本町368-4 セラヴィビル1F、18:00〜3:00、日曜定休、18席 (カウンター8席・テーブル2卓)、カード可、喫煙可、メニュー: 熊本直送 馬刺し4種盛り、北海道産 本ししゃも、和牛すじ煮込み、自家製ローストビーフ、徳島産 肉厚椎茸焼き、新潟特産 栃尾のジャンボ油揚げ (納豆・ネギ味噌・明太子マヨネーズ)、新潟産 イカ刺し明太子和え、男のポテトサラダ、京都産 銀鱈の西京焼き、海老フライ、国産鶏もも唐揚げ (カレー味・レモン醤油・おろし胡麻ポン酢)。食べログ: 郷土料理・日本酒バー・居酒屋、月〜土18:00〜翌3:00 (L.O. 2:30)、祝前日17:00〜24:00、日曜休み (月曜祝日なら日曜営業・月曜休み)、お通し代1人500円、混雑時2時間制、喫煙可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2013年11月26日オープン、インボイス: 安達 秀行 (個人)。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年11月、英語): 新潟出身のオーナー、豚汁、マカロニサラダ、肉じゃが、おでん。

cultural_comfort.note: Smoking allowed; ¥500 cover; mostly local regulars.

kyoto_sanjo_haku.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Sukiyaki is cooked in the house warishita and kaiseki starters use dashi; the current menu publishes no gluten information. The operator once announced a gluten-free wagyu sukiyaki kaiseki for inbound guests (press release, now offline; per a search summary) — confirm it is still offered (official menu, November 2026).
kyoto_sanjo_haku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu sukiyaki and shabu-shabu kaiseki with dashi-based starters (official menu).
kyoto_sanjo_haku.hours_raw: Dinner 17:00–22:00 (last entry 19:00); lunch 12:00–15:00 (last entry 13:00) Saturday, Sunday and holidays only; closed Tuesday (official site; Tabelog also lists Monday dinner). Reservation required; changes and cancellations at least 3 days ahead, 100% fee for cancelling the day before (Tabelog). Course prices on the site include tax and service; Tabelog lists a 10% service charge. Private-room fee ¥1,650 per person at dinner, ¥1,100 at lunch (official site); 2nd-floor hall ¥11,000 (Tabelog). 34 seats in private rooms (tables and sunken kotatsu), some over the Kamo River, with a terrace; designated smoking area; cards, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). English menu and staff; children welcome, with a ¥5,500 sukiyaki bento for children (Tabelog). Down a narrow stone path off Kiyamachi-dori north of Sanjo; 3 min from Sanjo Stn exit 7 (official site; Tabelog).
kyoto_sanjo_haku.notes: [Sukiyaki · Kiyamachi, private rooms over the Kamo River] A sukiyaki house in private rooms down a stone alley off Kiyamachi, in the building where the Bakumatsu samurai Takechi Hanpeita lodged when it was the ryotei 四国屋丹虎; some rooms look over the Kamo River, one onto a tsukubai garden by Kazuyuki Ishihara. Staff cook wagyu, Omi or Kobe beef sukiyaki at the table in the house warishita, after seasonal kaiseki starters; dinner from ¥24,500, weekend lunch from ¥12,100, service included. Reviewers praise the rooms and the river terrace; one found the sukiyaki too light. Run by the Kobe-based G LION GROUP. Closed Tuesday.

roles: 料理長 (head chef, not named); operator G LION GROUP (Kobe; representative 菊地 秀武)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: wagyu sukiyaki kaiseki in a new style by a cook long experienced in traditional Japanese cuisine, made in front of guests with the house warishita; the building was the ryotei 四国屋丹虎 in the Bakumatsu era, where 武市半平太 lived when in Kyoto, and the tokonoma board and pillar of the 半平の間 are kept unchanged; a box-staircase trace from that era was found during renovation; tsubo-niwa garden supervised by the garden designer 石原和幸. Press releases name the operator as the G LION GROUP of Kobe (representative 菊地 秀武), whose recruitment site describes about 150 group companies, mostly car dealerships. Tabelog Hot Pot "Tabelog 100" 2026 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: an out-of-the-ordinary sukiyaki experience — the seasons of Kyoto with all five senses.
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu, Omi and Kobe beef sukiyaki kaiseki.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 guest left something behind without noticing, and staff came outside to find the guest.
An April 2026 diner asked for a sake recommendation, was left waiting by a newer staff member and gave up, and found the meat cut thicker than liked.
A September 2026 diner, used to Kyushu-style sukiyaki, found the taste too light and refreshing.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (haku.kyoto): 京都三条 箔、鴨川を望む個室で味わう和牛すき焼き会席、伝統的な日本料理を経験した料理人による新しいスタイルの和牛すき焼き会席、箔特製の割り下、スタッフが目の前で作る、世界的な庭園デザイナー石原和幸氏監修の坪庭、木屋町通に面する、武市半平太寓居之跡、幕末は四国屋丹虎という料亭、半平の間の床板と床柱、中京区木屋町通三条上る上大阪町528-3、三条駅より徒歩3分、12時〜15時 (最終入店13時) 土日祝のみ、17時〜22時 (最終入店19時)、火曜定休、お品書き: 和牛すき焼き会席24,500円、近江牛すき焼き会席30,500円、近江牛しゃぶしゃぶ会席30,500円 (要予約)、神戸牛すき焼き会席36,500円、近江牛シャトーブリアンすき焼き会席42,500円 (税サ込)、ランチ 和牛すき焼き12,100円・和牛と近江牛食べ比べ18,150円・近江牛すき焼き24,200円、個室料金 昼1,100円・夜1,650円。プレスリリース (さんたつ): GLION GROUP (兵庫県神戸市、代表取締役 菊地秀武) が運営、年末年始の神戸・近江牛食べ比べすき焼き会席38,500円。食べログ: すき焼き・しゃぶしゃぶ・日本料理、サービス料10%、34席 (テーブル24、掘りごたつ10)、個室、分煙、カード・Alipay・WeChat Pay、英語メニュー、持ち込み可、鍋 百名店 2026。口コミ (2026年1〜10月、英語)。

kyoto_zen_kashoin_muromachi.gf_detail: Ask. The house sweets are paper-baked castella, dorayaki, cookies and Mont Blanc on castella; warabi mochi, ice cream and teas are also served, but no gluten information is published (official menu; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_zen_kashoin_muromachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Castella and the egg sweets use eggs, and parfaits use cream and ice cream; Japanese teas and coffee are plant-based, but no ingredient list is published for the warabi mochi or other sweets (official menu; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_zen_kashoin_muromachi.hours_raw: 11:00–18:00 daily, café last order 17:30; closed days posted on the store calendar (official site; Tabelog). No café bookings (official site). A Sunday 15:00 visitor in November 2026 found 5–6 groups waiting. 20 seats looking onto the inner garden; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Shop, café, gallery (Gallery SUGATA) and workshop in a wide-fronted townhouse dated 元禄十三年 (1700) on Muromachi-dori south of Nijo; 5–6 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn exit 2 (official site). Opened August 2009 (official site; Tabelog gives 8 August 2009). Fresh castella keeps about two days (October 2026).
kyoto_zen_kashoin_muromachi.notes: [Sweets & café · Muromachi, castella in a 1700 townhouse] The flagship of a castella maker in a broad-fronted Muromachi townhouse built in 1700, with an earthen entry, an old kamado and well, a gallery and a tearoom over an inner garden. Its paper-baked castella of Kyoto eggs comes as a three-piece tasting set with tea (¥1,760), and seasonal plates — chestnut Mont Blanc and dorayaki in autumn, grill-your-own dango in winter — come with a drink for about ¥1,870. No bookings; expect a queue at weekends. Run by 長崎堂 of Osaka, which also has a café in Shibuya Hikarie. Open daily 11:00–18:00.

roles: Operator 株式会社長崎堂 (Osaka; founded 1960; chairman 荒木 貴史); not a chef-led shop
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 然花抄院 opened its Kyoto Muromachi main store in August 2009 among old kimono merchants, with shop, café, gallery and workshop; the townhouse has a pillar inscribed with its building year, 元禄十三年, paving stones from the Kitano tram line, a well in the courtyard and kamado, and walls partly papered in karakami by 唐長; the name expresses hospitality with "a heart of flowers" and sweets in the true taste of each. The company page lists 株式会社長崎堂 (founded August 1960, capital ¥30 m) and two cafés, Kyoto Muromachi and Shibuya Hikarie ShinQs (opened April 2012), plus ZENKASHOIN gift shops in mass retailers and station and airport shops (official site). Tabelog Cafe WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "花も、菓も、然るべき姿へ" — flowers and sweets, each in its proper form; serving things plainly, without affectation.
chef_bio.specialty: Paper-baked "Zen" castella; seasonal sweet plates with tea.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 visitor was intimidated by the size of the entrance but relieved by the warm welcome, and found the chestnut plate fair value with a drink included.
An October 2026 visitor ordered warabi mochi but was most moved by the salty-sour ume bancha.
An October 2026 visitor wanted to take home lots of fresh castella but bought one, as it keeps only until the next day.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (zen-kashoin.com): 京都室町御菓子司 然花抄院、2009年8月に京都室町通りに京都室町本店、物販・カフェ・ギャラリー・工房、建立元禄十三年の町家、北野行ちんちん電車の敷石、中庭や竃の井戸、唐長の唐紙、花ある心でおもてなし、「花も、菓も、然るべき姿へ」、茶寮「然カフェ」、中京区室町通二条下ル蛸薬師町271-1、11:00〜18:00 (喫茶17:30 L.O.)、喫茶の席の予約不可、烏丸御池駅2番出口より徒歩6分、渋谷ヒカリエ ShinQs店 (2012年4月)、ZENKASHOIN (ギフト商品、量販店・駅空港土産店)、お品書き: やきたてみたらし団子1,870円 (11月1日〜5月31日)、実ノ膳1,870円、お芋パフェ紫月夜1,870円、くりーむあんみつ秋1,870円、茶庭ノ膳1,760円、宝卵ノ膳1,650円、「然」アイス1,320円 (いずれもドリンク付)、煎茶・玄米茶・梅番茶・焙じ茶・昆布茶・京番茶880円、抹茶990円、竹炭焙煎コーヒー880円。会社概要: 株式会社長崎堂、1960年8月創業、資本金3,000万円、代表取締役会長 荒木貴史、和洋菓子の製造及び販売。食べログ: カフェ・和菓子・甘味処、20席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2009年8月8日オープン、運営: 長崎堂 (心斎橋)、カフェ WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年11月、英語): ざらめカステラ702円。

kyoto_tokishirazu_belgian_beer.gf_detail: Ask. Beer bar food — fries, pizza, pasta, risotto, carbonnade and course menus — alongside a long beer list; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tokishirazu_belgian_beer.vegan_detail: Ask. Caprese, marinated vegetables and fries appear, but most dishes are mussels, meat, cheese and seafood (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tokishirazu_belgian_beer.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–24:00 (food last order 23:00, drinks 23:30); irregular closures, and private hire for parties (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Courses with all-you-can-drink, e.g. 9 dishes + 120 min for ¥4,400 (Tabelog); a ¥4,200 course with two drinks (November 2025). No service or table charge (Tabelog). 44 seats: 8 at the counter, 36 at tables; private hire 20–50+; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Third floor of プラネシア六角柳馬場, up a steep straight stair (November 2025); 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_tokishirazu_belgian_beer.notes: [Belgian beer · Yanagibaba Rokkaku, 120 Belgian beers] A big third-floor beer hall south of Rokkaku with about 120 Belgian beers plus Czech and German drafts, and generous European plates alongside: white-wine mussels with fries, beef-cheek carbonnade, ajillo, pizza and pasta. Courses with all-you-can-drink make it a party favourite, but there is a counter for two. The stairs are steep after a few beers; one guest found the tables cramped. Open nightly to midnight.

roles: Staff (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: one of the largest Belgian beer selections in Kyoto, with about 120 varieties, and European cooking that combines Belgian regional dishes with Italian and Spanish flavours; 53 seats in all, used for parties. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe banquets with all-you-can-drink, attentive staff and generous portions.
chef_bio.philosophy: Pairing Belgian beer with European dishes (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Mussels steamed in white wine; Belgian beer.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 couple who missed the Belgian pavilion at the Osaka Expo came here instead, drank Belgian, Czech and German beers, and had the white-wine mussels made into pasta.
A November 2025 guest held onto the handrail going down: the stairs run straight up to the third floor and "can be dangerous for those who have had a few drinks."
"The portion sizes of the food were quite generous, so by the time I had sampled all the beers, I was completely full" — February 2026.
"However, the tables were a bit cramped, which was unfortunate." — September 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Third floor up a steep stair; à la carte or all-you-can-drink courses; cards accepted.

kyoto_sobaya_takehana.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura, yuba tempura and dashi-and-soy broths; the soba is stone-milled and handmade, but no source says it is 100% buckwheat (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sobaya_takehana.vegan_detail: Not vegan: soba served in dashi broth, with shrimp tempura, herring and chicken teriyaki among the toppings (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sobaya_takehana.hours_raw: 11:00–21:30 (last order 21:00); closed Monday and the second Tuesday of the month (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); short waits around lunchtime (January 2025). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 16 seats: 8 at the counter and four tables for two (Tabelog). About 20 m east of Kennin-ji, 7 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Keihan) (Tabelog). Sake and shochu for daytime drinking (Tabelog; May 2025).
kyoto_sobaya_takehana.notes: [Soba · beside Kennin-ji, thin handmade noodles] A 16-seat soba shop a few steps from Kennin-ji, serving thin, stone-milled handmade soba from late morning to evening: ume tororo, lemon soba, nishin soba and tempura zaru, mostly ¥1,190–1,790, with sake and small dishes for daytime drinking. Reviews split on the noodles — praised for the cut and lightness, faulted by some for lacking firmness in hot broth. Cash only, no bookings. Closed Monday and the second Tuesday.

roles: Staff (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: authentic handmade soba from stone-milled flour; children welcome. A May 2026 reviewer says the shop has been near Kennin-ji for a long time; a September 2024 reviewer describes an old building with a newer interior.
chef_bio.specialty: Ume tororo soba; lemon soba; tempura zaru soba.

anecdotes.text: The soba came with a little plover-shaped flag stuck in pickled daikon — "The cute Chidori flag" (September 2024).
A November 2024 diner found the noodles in hot chicken teriyaki soba too soft, "falling apart" on the chopsticks.
"The fact that this soba shop allows for daytime drinking makes it a must-visit." — May 2025.
"The broth tasted somewhat commercial … On the positive side, the soba was expertly cut" — April 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: そば、東山区小松町560-2、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩約7分、Kennin-ji の東約20m、火〜日 11:00〜21:30 (L.O.21:00)、月曜と第2火曜休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、16席 (カウンター8、2人席4)、日本酒・焼酎、子ども可、石臼挽きの手打ちそば。口コミ (2024年1月〜2026年5月、英語): 細いそば、天ぷらそば・天ざる1,790円、にしんそば1,390円、とろろそば1,190円、梅とろろ、レモンそば、照り焼きチキンそば、湯葉の天ぷら、昼飲み、千鳥の旗、温かいそばはコシが弱いとの声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; no reservations; small counter shop.

kyoto_kappo_shinatomi.gf_detail: Ask. Kappo courses and à la carte with dashi, white and red miso, tempura, karasumi mochi, fried fugu and saba sushi; no gluten information (2022–2025 reviews).
kyoto_kappo_shinatomi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a kappo of fish, shellfish, sea urchin, Tanba black wagyu and dashi-based dishes (Tabelog; 2022–2025 reviews).
kyoto_kappo_shinatomi.hours_raw: 17:30–22:00, last entry 19:00, no second sitting; for same-day bookings call by 18:00; closed Wednesday and about twice a month (Tabelog). Reservation only; Tabelog bookings are seated by the house — call for the counter or a private room; reservations cannot be taken from anyone without a Japanese phone number (Tabelog). Tabelog's machine-translated note says bookings are for course meals, while reviewers 2022–2025 ordered à la carte. 10% service charge (Tabelog). 7 counter seats and private rooms for 2–3; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). East of the Imperial Palace near Teramachi and Marutamachi; 10 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi (Keihan) or Shiyakusho-mae (subway) (Tabelog; 2023, 2025 reviews).
kyoto_kappo_shinatomi.notes: [Kappo · east of the Imperial Palace, à la carte by a couple] A seven-seat kappo counter east of the Imperial Palace, opened in 2021 by chef Shuichi Takahashi after kappo work in Gion, with the hostess in the room. Take a course built around the day, or order à la carte — grilled hon-moroko, sweetfish with roe, white-miso hot pot, wagyu with sea urchin — at an unhurried pace. Bills run ¥20,000–30,000 with 10% service; one 2024 guest found it a little dear. Reservations need a Japanese phone number. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner-chef
Hostess (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: A March 2025 reviewer: "Chef Shuichi Takahashi, who gained experience at kappou in Gion, opened this establishment in 2021"; the shop's name reflects its location (the address is 信富町). An August 2024 reviewer: "Apparently, the chef used to work at Umezu in Gion." Reviewers describe a couple — "Authentic Kappou Cuisine by a Warm Couple" (November 2023), "both the owner and the hostess were very pleasant" (October 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: "We do not rush our guests, so please take your time and enjoy your meal" (the shop's statement, quoted March 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: À la carte kappo; white-miso hot pot; grilled river fish.

anecdotes.text: "Moreover, the fact that the maru-nabe (round hot pot) is served in smaller pots is simply outstanding." — March 2022.
A November 2023 diner singled out sweetfish with roe simmered with sansho — a sauce worth pouring over rice at home.
"However, I felt that the price was a bit high for what I received." — February 2024.
"The grilled fugu was surprisingly flavorful, reminiscent of fried chicken" — March 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・魚介料理、上京区信富町315-4、神宮丸太町駅・市役所前駅から徒歩10分、月火木〜日 17:30〜22:00 (最終入店19:00、二回転制なし、当日予約は18時まで)、水曜と月2回の不定休、完全予約制、食べログ予約は席の指定不可、日本の電話番号がない方の予約不可、サービス料10%、7席 (カウンター)、2〜3名の個室、禁煙、カード・PayPay 可、旬の魚介、京野菜、Tanba の黒毛和牛、コースとアラカルト。口コミ (2022年3月〜2025年10月、英語): 店主 Shuichi Takahashi は祇園の割烹で経験を積み2021年に開店、梅津にいたとの話 (2024年8月)、夫婦の店、本もろこ、子持ち鮎、白味噌の鍋、ふぐの焼き物、白子、蛤、鯖寿司、値段がやや高いとの声 (2024年2月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservations only, and not from anyone without a Japanese phone number; ask a hotel to book. 10% service; cards accepted.

kyoto_gion_rakumi.gf_detail: Ask. You choose ingredients and cooking methods, so dishes vary — tempura, gratin, hamburg steak and curry appear alongside sashimi and grilled fish; no gluten information (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_rakumi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a counter built around fish, crab, sea urchin and wagyu from the day's ingredient box (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_rakumi.hours_raw: Monday to Saturday 17:30–23:00; closed Sunday and the second and fourth Monday (Tabelog). The official site (page last updated 2022) lists two dinner sittings, 17:30–20:20 (last entry 18:30) and 20:30–23:00 (last entry 21:30), a lunch from 12:00 or 12:30, and irregular closures. Reservations up to the end of the second month ahead (official site). Average about ¥20,000 at dinner and ¥7,000 at lunch (official site); reviewers spent ¥15,000–49,999 (2025–2026). 14 seats at a counter; private hire possible; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards and e-money (Tabelog). Facing Minamiza-koji in Gion south of Shijo, near Yasaka Shrine; 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; August 2026).
kyoto_gion_rakumi.notes: [Kappo izakaya · Gion, choose your ingredient and cooking] Gion Sasaki's "adult kappo izakaya" on Minamiza-koji: a high-ceilinged 14-seat counter where a young, cheerful team shows you the day's ingredient box and cooks whatever you pick, however you like — grilled over the central charcoal, simmered, fried, even wok-tossed — in portions you set. Nodoguro, crab gratin, wagyu, corn tempura and curry are favourites. Expect ¥20,000–30,000 or more. Listed in OAD 2026 (per a reviewer). Closed Sunday and the second and fourth Monday.

roles: A young team of chefs (unnamed), of the Gion Sasaki group
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, one of the Gion Sasaki group's shops (with Gion Sasaki, Sushi Rakumi and Shoku Bar Rakumi), themed "大人の割烹居酒屋" (an adult kappo izakaya). An August 2026 reviewer: opened in November 2013, "known as a restaurant run by the chef of 'Gion Sasaki'", and listed in OAD Top Restaurants 2026; a March 2026 reviewer thought it is run by the owner's son. Reviewers in 2026 describe a young, energetic team of chefs.
chef_bio.philosophy: Guests choose the ingredients and decide with the chefs how each is cooked (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Ingredients cooked to order over charcoal; nodoguro; crab gratin.

anecdotes.text: "I think this is the first time I've seen a Chinese wok in a Japanese restaurant!" — March 2026.
A March 2026 guest took the suggestion of sea urchin on top of shrimp for sashimi — "that luxurious combination!"
"Be careful not to overindulge, as it can impact your budget!" — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (祇園さゝ木): 祇園楽味、テーマは「大人の割烹居酒屋」、全国各地や時には世界から仕入れた旬の食材をネタ箱に並べ、客が選んだ食材の食べ方を相談して決める、カウンター中央の炭火、昼12:00・12:30〜、夜は17:30〜20:20 (最終入店18:30) と20:30〜23:00 (最終入店21:30)、平均予算は昼7,000円・夜20,000円、日曜・第2第4月曜・不定休、予約は2か月先の末日まで、東山区祇園町南側570-206、グループに祇園さゝ木、鮨楽味、食ばぁー楽味。食べログ: 日本料理、月〜土 17:30〜23:00、14席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー可。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年9月、英語): 若い料理人たち、のどぐろの煮付け、和牛ステーキ、蟹グラタン、とうもろこしの天ぷら、ハンバーグ、カレー、中華鍋も、2013年11月開店、OAD 2026。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; staff show the ingredients and explain choices; cards accepted.

kyoto_ful_kawaramachi.gf_detail: Ask. The official food menu marks allergens, including wheat, dish by dish; most of the food is bread, pasta, batter or spring-roll pastry, and even the rice-flour cake is marked as containing wheat (official menu, February 2026).
kyoto_ful_kawaramachi.vegan_detail: The official menu has grilled eggplant vegan nachos (¥850) and a plant-based mark; seasonal vegetables come with a miso, soy-milk and cashew dip (official menu, February 2026; May 2026). Most other dishes have meat, cheese or egg.
kyoto_ful_kawaramachi.hours_raw: Tue–Thu and Sun 17:00–24:00 (last orders food 23:00, drinks 23:30); Fri–Sat 17:00–03:00 (last orders food 2:00, drinks 2:30); closed Monday (official site; Tabelog gives 17:00–24:00 for Friday and Saturday too). Happy hour from 17:00 — a glass of champagne with prosciutto for ¥2,000 (February 2026). Reservations accepted; courses for 2–10, phone for 11 or more (Tabelog). No minors (Tabelog). 10% service charge in the dining and lounge areas (Tabelog; official menu). 80 seats in three areas — counter, sofas and lounge — standing for 120; private hire for 50 or more; non-smoking, smoking area outside; wheelchair accessible; English menu and English-speaking staff; cards, IC cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). On a side street off Kawaramachi south of Sanjo, ground floor; 3 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; September 2026).
kyoto_ful_kawaramachi.notes: [Music bar & natural wine · Kawaramachi Sanjo, a forest under ten speakers] A big, dim lounge just off Kawaramachi, produced by Fantastic Plastic Machine's Tomoyuki Tanaka, with a huge tree at its centre, plants everywhere and ten ceiling speakers. Come for natural wine — more than 120 bottles — or cocktails, plus bar food: the dashimaki brioche sandwich, sukiyaki spring rolls, tacos and shake-bag fries. Courses from ¥4,500; 10% service in the lounge. Some find the music too loud. Adults only; until 3:00 on Friday and Saturday.

roles: Bar and restaurant; kitchen staff unnamed
chef_bio.background: Per Metropolis and 2026 reviews: the "Sound Forest" concept is by producer Tomoyuki Tanaka, known as Fantastic Plastic Machine, music director for the opening and closing ceremonies of the Tokyo 2020 Olympics and Paralympics (February 2026 review); natural wines chosen by sommelier Kei Tashiro and cocktails by bartender Keita Saito (Metropolis). Opened 12 July 2024 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Natural wine; dashimaki brioche sandwich.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 diner liked the food and service but found the music "as loud as in a movie theater".
A November 2025 diner found it noisy and too brightly lit, and was given a table after booking the counter.
A March 2026 diner described ten speakers in the ceiling and a huge old tree in the middle of the room.

kyoto_ryurei_chashitsu_sabi.gf_detail: Ask. A fixed course of five sweets with teas; the sweets change monthly and use mochi (gyuhi), miso, herbs and fruit; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ryurei_chashitsu_sabi.vegan_detail: Not vegan as served: the July 2026 sweets included fermented milk and caramel (July 2026). Ask when booking.
kyoto_ryurei_chashitsu_sabi.hours_raw: 12:00–18:00 daily, open year-round, by reservation only (Tabelog); three sittings a day (July 2026). One course: the tea-and-sweets kaiseki, ¥7,700 with tax, with the same price whether the paired drinks are alcoholic or not (July and September 2026). 8 counter seats; private hire; non-smoking; cards only, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Second floor of a building on the 570 block south of Shijo in Gion, 7 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). A second shop, 然美 御所南, is listed on the official site.
kyoto_ryurei_chashitsu_sabi.notes: [Tea & sweets course · Gion, a monthly pairing at an 8-seat counter] A hushed second-floor counter south of Shijo where each guest gets one course: five seasonal sweets, each paired with a tea brewed in front of you — gyokuro, hojicha with spice, matcha — with tea cocktails if you choose the alcohol pairing, at the same ¥7,700. Expect fruit, herbs and miso in the sweets, and pickles to finish. Book a sitting; one March 2026 guest found the service lacking.

roles: Tea room; staff unnamed
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded by the contemporary artist Taiga Takahashi (1995–2022). Opened 4 December 2021 (Tabelog). The shop text speaks of "rust" — the beauty of change over time and imperfection — and of sukiya-style architecture (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): the beauty of imperfection and imbalance, "the essence hidden deep within gradually seeps out with the passage of time."
chef_bio.specialty: Tea and sweets kaiseki.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner found the course dragging, had a drink taken away unfinished, and saw a fallen sweet taken to the back and fixed by hand; the diner did not plan to return.
A September 2026 diner felt the teas and sweets each leave room for the other, more a flow than a series of peaks.
"The first cup of tea was truly exquisite, with a flavor reminiscent of dashi that I had never encountered before" — April 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (rustsabi.com): 立礼茶室「然美」、祇園と御所南、創設者は現代芸術家の髙橋大雅 (1995〜2022)。食べログ: カフェ、東山区祇園町南側570-120 T.T 2F、祇園四条駅から徒歩7分、12:00〜18:00、要予約、年中無休、カウンター8席、貸切可、禁煙、カード可 (電子マネー・QR 不可)、2021年12月4日オープン、店の紹介は Rust (時を経た変化の美) と不完全の美、数寄屋造り。口コミ (2024年10月〜2026年9月、英語): 茶菓懐石7,700円、1日3部制、ノンアルコールとアルコールは同額、甘味5品とお茶、ほうじ茶にカルダモン、抹茶ジン、最後に漬物、接客に不満という声。

kyoto_gion_nishimura.hours_raw: Mon–Sat from 17:00, last entry 20:00; closed Sunday (official site; Tabelog). Reservation only; the phone may be hard to reach during service (Tabelog). 17% service charge (Tabelog). 20 seats: a counter (8 per Tabelog; six per a June 2024 review) and tatami private rooms for 2 to 20, some upstairs with a courtyard view; counter non-smoking (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews). Cards accepted (official site). Down a lane on the 570 block south of Shijo in Gion, 370 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; January 2024).
kyoto_gion_nishimura.notes: [Kaiseki · Gion, sesame tofu and saba sushi down a lane] A traditional kaiseki house tucked into a Gion back lane, with a counter and tatami rooms, some upstairs over a courtyard. Chef Akihiko Nishimura's nine or ten dishes run from a silky sesame tofu and a clear dashi soup through sashimi and a famous saba sushi to sea-bream chazuke; the saba sushi is also sold to take home. One June 2026 diner found the seasoning on the strong side. Reviewers spent about ¥20,000–30,000 a head; a 17% service charge applies. Mon–Sat evenings, reservation only.

roles: Chef (October 2025 review)
chef_bio.background: Per an October 2025 reviewer: a renowned Kyoto-cuisine restaurant in Gion where chef Akihiko Nishimura cooks a delicate seasonal kaiseki around the counter. A December 2023 diner found the head chef and the hostess warm and cheerful; an April 2025 diner enjoyed the chef’s stories.
chef_bio.specialty: Sesame tofu; saba sushi.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 diner liked everything but found the flavours strong — the saba sushi salty, the sesame tofu rich — and was left thirsty.
A June 2024 diner, there with a friend from abroad, was put at ease by the friendly chef at the six-seat counter.
A January 2024 party was shown to a tatami room with a sunken table, its own restroom and a view of the courtyard.

kyoto_trattoria_annamaria.gf_detail: Ask. The menu is built on handmade wheat pasta (tagliatelle, bigoli, tortellini) and Modena breads such as tigelle and gnocco fritto; the meat mains and cured meats may be options (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_trattoria_annamaria.vegan_detail: Ask. Northern Italian cooking centred on meat, cheese and cream; no seafood is served (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_trattoria_annamaria.hours_raw: Dinner Tue–Sun 17:00–22:00 (last seating 21:00); lunch Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–14:30 (last seating 13:00), by reservation made by the day before; closed Monday (open on holidays) and irregularly — check Instagram for closures (Tabelog). Lunch set ¥2,750 or a two-pasta lunch course ¥5,500 (September 2026). Dinner booking advised — full on a holiday evening (September 2026). 14 seats at five tables; no service charge (Tabelog, Japanese text). Non-smoking; cards and IC cards (Tabelog). Up the hill east of Gojo, next to the Shimobamacho post office; 4 min from the Umamachi bus stop, 15 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog; September 2026).
kyoto_trattoria_annamaria.notes: [Italian · Umamachi, Emilia-Romagna pasta up the hill] A 14-seat trattoria up the slope east of Gojo, where a chef trained at Antica Moka in Emilia-Romagna rolls tagliatelle by hand, presses bigoli and floats tortellini in brodo. Lunch on weekends is a bargain — soup, a plate of antipasti with gnocco fritto and prosciutto, and a pasta for ¥2,750 — booked by the day before. Dinners add Modena tigelle, cotoletta and slow-braised meats, and tiramisu. No seafood, no service charge. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): the chef trained at Ristorante Antica Moka, known for handmade pasta, in Emilia-Romagna; a September 2026 reviewer places the training in Modena. Opened 12 October 2023 (Tabelog) in a space that had been a classic French restaurant (October 2026 regular).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): traditional northern Italian dishes as they are actually eaten locally.
chef_bio.specialty: Handmade pasta.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner asked to try more dishes and was given half portions of the prosciutto and gnocco fritto and slightly smaller pastas.
A September 2026 diner swapped the bigoli for gargati, a short Veneto pasta, with the cream pesto.
A regular since before the opening marked the third anniversary in October 2026, noting the evening second course takes 45 minutes to prepare.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・パスタ、東山区下馬町491 アースコート清水 1F、馬町バス停から徒歩4分、清水五条駅から徒歩15分、火〜金 17:00〜22:00、土日 12:00〜14:30・17:00〜22:00、ランチ最終入店13:00、ディナー最終入店21:00、ランチは前日までの予約制、月曜休み (祝日は営業)・不定休、サービス料なし、14席、禁煙、カード・交通系IC可、2023年10月12日オープン、Antica Moka で修業したシェフのエミリア・ロマーニャの手打ちパスタ、魚介は出さない。口コミ (2025〜2026年10月、英語と日本語): ランチセット2,750円、パスタ2種のランチコース5,500円、tagliatelle、bigoli、tortellini in brodo、tigelle、gnocco fritto、ティラミス、3周年。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone (lunch by the day before); staff explain the pasta shapes; cards accepted.

kyoto_aketotemoro.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the dishes named are mostly pork, shrimp, duck and meat miso (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_aketotemoro.hours_raw: 18:00–1:00 daily (food last order 23:30, drinks 0:30); closing days not fixed — monthly closures on Instagram @ake.totemoro (Tabelog). Bookings taken; a reviewer says book, as it fills within 30 minutes of opening (August 2026). 21 places: 13 counter seats and 8 standing; private hire up to 20; non-smoking until 23:00, smoking allowed inside after 23:00 (Tabelog; August 2026). Bottled beer and sours are self-serve from the fridge, with an opener on the table; all-you-can-drink available (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Cards, IC cards and QR (Tabelog). At the corner of Kawaramachi and Matsubara; 6 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog; May 2026).
kyoto_aketotemoro.notes: [Izakaya & standing bar · Kawaramachi-Matsubara, open to 1 am] A nostalgic, dimly lit bar on the corner under a scarlet sign: grab a bottled beer from the fridge yourself, then order garlic shrimp, spring rolls or the garlic pork yaki udon. Counter or standing; about ¥3,000–4,000. Run by two people, so service can be slow (2026 reviews). Smoking allowed inside after 23:00.

roles: Operator unnamed in the sources
chef_bio.background: Per the operator: a nostalgic, Taisho-era-style room behind a tiled front and large windows, with lighting that dims as the night goes on. Two 2026 reviewers say it is run by two people (June and August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Garlic shrimp; garlic pork yaki udon.

anecdotes.text: Staying at a nearby hotel in November 2025, a visitor was drawn in by the bright red sign and found a mostly twenty-something crowd.
A June 2026 diner found the service "a bit hit or miss" with two people running the room, but reasonably quick.
Without a booking, two December 2025 diners were found seats anyway.

kyoto_gion_shizuka.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Kyoto kaiseki with sushi, sukiyaki, a kadaif-coated croquette, udon and ponzu; the official site has a notice on ingredient restrictions (April 2026) that we could not read (Tabelog; 2026 reviews; official site).
kyoto_gion_shizuka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of fish, foie gras, sea urchin, wagyu and dashi (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_shizuka.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 12:30); dinner from 18:00, all guests starting together, booking required; no regular closing day (official site; Tabelog). Tabelog gives dinner to 22:00, the official site to 21:00. Pairing courses by advance booking only; bookings may be cancelled after 15 minutes' unannounced lateness (Tabelog). No children under 12; everyone 12 and over orders a course; no very casual clothes or strong perfume; please do not leave your seat to smoke during the meal (Tabelog). Service 10%, included in some prices (Tabelog). 18 seats: a 10-seat counter and a 2nd-floor tatami room for 2–8 (room charge); English menu; English- and Chinese-speaking staff; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). Near the Tatsumi bridge on the Shirakawa; 5 min from Gion-Shijo or Sanjo-Keihan Stn (Tabelog; September 2026).
kyoto_gion_shizuka.notes: [Kaiseki & sake pairing · Gion Shirakawa] A ten-seat counter in a renovated machiya near the Tatsumi bridge, where seasonal Kyoto kaiseki comes with pairings of rare sake (Juyondai among them) kept at –5 °C. The cooking is credited to a Michelin-starred chef. Dinner courses about ¥16,500–26,400 + service; lunch too. No under-12s; English menu. Open daily.

roles: Supervising chef: "Kazumi Sawada" per Tabelog (romaji only; a Michelin star in 2008 and 2009)
Head chef unnamed on the official site; a September 2026 reviewer names "Chef Kimura"
chef_bio.background: Opened 29 July 2024 (Tabelog). Per Tabelog: a 10-course Kyoto kaiseki by chef Kazumi Sawada, "who has earned a Michelin star" (2008 and 2009), with Kyoto vegetables, wagyu and Setouchi seafood. The official site credits a Michelin-starred chef with supervising the food and names no one; it is run by EDGE (ed-ge.co.jp), whose other venues listed on the site are in Tokyo.
chef_bio.specialty: Kaiseki with sake pairings.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner was touched by "the warm hospitality of Chef Kimura and the staff".
In September and October the room keeps crickets, so the meal comes with their song — September 2026.
An October 2026 family calls it the family favourite, above all for the sake pairings, and hopes it stays easy to book.

kyoto_gion_kawakami.hours_raw: 12:00–15:00 and 17:30–22:00 daily; holidays posted on the official site (a November–December 2026 notice) (Tabelog; official site). Bookings by phone or online (TableCheck) (official site; Tabelog). A lunch kaiseki was ¥6,600 with tax, service extra (September 2026). 24 seats: a 10-seat counter and seven private rooms across the main house and annex (Tabelog; February 2026). Non-smoking; JCB, AMEX and Diners (Tabelog). Takeaway seasonal bento in November only, ¥5,250, two days' notice, no shipping (official site). On a lane one street west of Hanamikoji, south of Shijo; 248 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_kawakami.notes: [Kappo · Gion, since 1960] A Gion kappo in a 100-year-old machiya on a quiet lane off Hanamikoji, with a bright counter where you watch the cooks and private rooms behind. No fixed menu: the day's market sets the dishes. Lunch kaiseki around ¥6,600 or a bento is the easy way in; dinners run ¥20,000+. A reviewer notes a Michelin star.

roles: Owner (店主, signs the official site, unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in 1960 (Showa 35) in the middle of Gion; motto "親切・センス・鮮度" (kindness, sense, freshness) kept since the founding; teamwork among the cooks at the counter. Per a February 2026 reviewer: a renovated machiya over 100 years old, a 10-seat counter and seven private rooms, and one Michelin star.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: no set monthly menu — the day's ingredients and each guest's wishes make the menu; bring out each ingredient's own aroma and taste.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kappo; kabura-mushi in winter.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 diner warned the chef's sharp style "might not appeal to those who lack a refined palate" — and praised the dashi-maki.
A June 2026 visitor with business at Minami-za dropped in for the Chochin bento and found lunch very reasonable.
Sake runs just under ¥2,000 for 180 ml, and the staff gladly suggest pairings — February 2026.

kyoto_mane.vegan_detail: Not vegan: "We cannot accommodate vegetarian requests. We do not have a vegan menu." A seafood-only course can be arranged (Tabelog).
kyoto_mane.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 12:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Monday, open on some Mondays (Tabelog). Allergies handled where possible, but not fish or wheat (Tabelog). 16 seats: 12 at the counter and one table, facing a garden; private hire up to 20; children of all ages welcome; English menu and staff; smart casual; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 7 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_mane.notes: [Creative Italian · near Kyoto City Hall] Moved from Kyotanabe in 2024 after eight years there: a bright 12-seat counter facing a small garden, serving inventive, seafood-led Italian courses with Japanese and other Asian touches. Lunch from ¥8,360, dinner about ¥17,000; plus ¥880 for water. Cannot cater for wheat allergies, vegetarians or vegans. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Opened here 23 April 2024 (Tabelog). Per 2026 reviews: previously in Matsuiyamate, Kyotanabe City, for about eight years before moving (May and August 2026); the name is the Scandinavian word for moon, written "måne" (May 2026); a July 2026 reviewer writes the chef trained at Yonemura and Il Ghiottone, and that the restaurant was selected by Michelin. Per the operator: the tables came from the old premises.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal seafood Italian courses.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner who dislikes coffee still wanted more of the tiramisu.
An October 2026 reviewer read the cooking as fusion, with Japanese, Chinese and Korean touches.
A passer-by of more than two years had never noticed it, then came for the duck — August 2026.

kyoto_nihonshu_to_sakana_ichiyo.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, simmered and grilled fish, with fried dishes (mehikari kara-age, Tochio fried tofu, spring rolls) that are not gluten-free (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nihonshu_to_sakana_ichiyo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-and-sake izakaya (2025–2026 reviews).

Reviewers also describe a ¥1,000 lunch that sells out (November 2025; October 2026); lunch hours are not listed. Reservations accepted; often full (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Cards accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). 20 seats, counter-centred (Tabelog; March 2026). Near Karasuma, 297 m from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog). Opened 1 August 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_nihonshu_to_sakana_ichiyo.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo-Karasuma, sake tastings and fish] A calm, counter-centred izakaya near Karasuma with two pages of sake — Aramasa, Jikon and rarer bottles — where the owner pours you tastings until you find the one you like. The food is fish-led and mostly under ¥1,000 a dish: thick sashimi, namero, simmered sawara, fried mehikari, grilled squid, with matsutake dobin-mushi in autumn. A ¥1,000 lunch set sells out. Book ahead; open nightly to midnight.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who guides the sake choices

No reservations (Tabelog); long queues after opening, quieter mid-afternoon on weekdays (September 2026). Cards and QR accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). kyoto_soup_curry_king_shinkyogoku.notes: [Soup curry · Shinkyogoku, Sapporo’s soup curry comes to Kyoto] The first Kansai branch of a Sapporo soup-curry name, up a flight on the Shinkyogoku arcade south of Sanjo, opened in January 2026. An October 2026 diner, lured in by a Wednesday-discount sign, ran out of soup halfway and ordered more.

kyoto_gion_izuju.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto pressed sushi with sweet-simmered fillings, kombu and tare-grilled hamo; the awafu roll uses wheat-gluten fu; no gluten information (official site).
kyoto_gion_izuju.vegan_detail: Limited: most sushi is fish, but the site offers shojin (Buddhist vegetarian) sushi boxes to order, the awafu roll is cooked shojin-style, and there is an eight-seaweed roll; the inari is simmered fried tofu — ask about the simmering (official site).
kyoto_gion_izuju.hours_raw: 10:30–17:00, Monday, Tuesday and Friday–Sunday and holidays; closed Wednesday and Thursday (a holiday closure moves to the next day); may close early when sold out (Tabelog; official site for the closed days). The official English page gives older hours to 19:00. No reservations for tables; takeaway with or without ordering ahead (official site). Saba-zushi orders suspended for lack of good mackerel (official site; Tabelog, end of April 2026; July–September 2026 reviews). Reopened 5 September after a long renovation closure, its longest since 1945 (official site). Cards: VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: tables and two semi-private tatami booths for three (Tabelog). Non-smoking; children welcome; English menu (Tabelog). At the northwest corner of the crossing below the Yasaka Shrine steps (official site).
kyoto_gion_izuju.notes: [Sushi · Gion, Kyoto pressed sushi below Yasaka Shrine] An old sushi house at the foot of the Yasaka Shrine steps, making Kyoto sushi — pressed boxes, saba-zushi, rolls — much as it has since the late Meiji era. The famous saba-zushi is on hold until good mackerel returns (the owner would rather not sell than sell poor fish), but the layered jo-hako box, shima-aji sushi, inari with crunchy hemp seeds and seasonal sasamaki carry on. No bookings; arrive at 10:30 to beat the queue. Closed Wednesday and Thursday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who signs the site’s notices and explains each sushi
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Kyoto sushi made by methods kept almost unchanged since the founding in the late Meiji era, more than a hundred years from the first-generation owner, 重吉. The shop reopened on a 5 September after its longest closure since the forced evacuations at the end of the war in 1945. Takeaway is also sold at counters in Kyoto Station, the Takashimaya stores in Kyoto and Osaka, and Abeno Harukas. A July 2026 reviewer calls the owner a living encyclopedia of Gion and Kyoto.
chef_bio.philosophy: “Better to give up and not sell than to sell poor mackerel” — the owner’s note on suspending saba-zushi (official site); keep old methods alive so that Kyoto sushi has a future (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Saba sugata-zushi; jo-hako-zushi.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 lunch guest was told the small batch of rice had run out and to come back in an hour; on return the empty room filled up fast.
An August 2026 diner nearly left on hearing there was no mackerel sushi, but was offered hamo and ayu sushi instead.
A September 2026 diner arrived on the very day the inari came back, and liked the crunch of hemp seeds in the rice.

kyoto_elove.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; the lunch sets come with house focaccia (or multigrain rice with the hamburg steak), and pasta is a course; the rest of the courses are vegetables, fish and meat (official site).
kyoto_elove.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetables lead every dish and Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the set courses include fish, venison, boar or wagyu, and desserts include a white-miso tiramisu (official site; 2026 reviews).

kyoto_elove.notes: [Italian · Shijo-Karasuma, vegetables first] A two-floor wooden dining room by Karasuma Station where every course is built on the day’s vegetables from Kyoto contract farms — diners pick vegetables to be grilled or fried, and the white-miso tiramisu is a favourite. Lunch course ¥2,500; dinner course with a drink ¥6,800; a deli and a vegetable stand too. Several diners warn the portions are generous. One of six shops of the local Ushinohone group.

roles: One of six shops of the うしのほねグループ (株式会社セカンダイズ); the chef is not named in a source
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Italian with vegetables as the star, using around 20 kinds of morning-picked vegetables sent daily by contract farmers, with a vegetable stand and a deli; the site lists named farms behind each dish. The group site (株式会社セカンダイズ) says the うしのほねグループ runs six shops of different styles in central Kyoto plus an online shop; ELOVE’s site lists the other five as sister shops. Opened 18 September 2021 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: to pass on, in the restaurant’s own way, the vegetables producers want people to eat now — not the textbook season but "delicious at this moment".
chef_bio.specialty: Daily vegetable courses; white-miso and sweet-potato tiramisu.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner found a thank-you card at the table addressed to the diner by name, and a menu dated for the day.

kyoto_obanzai_tsubomi_gion.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; a dashi-seasoned obanzai platter is served to everyone on sitting down, and the menu runs to tempura, fried oysters and udon (2023–2025 reviews).

kyoto_obanzai_tsubomi_gion.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sun 17:30–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); closed Monday, and may close two Sundays a month for a two-day break; lunch (booking only) is suspended. kyoto_obanzai_tsubomi_gion.notes: [Obanzai · Gion, open till midnight] Up a lift behind a lattice on Hanamikoji: two sunken U-shaped counters around a friendly owner, where an obanzai platter (¥2,200 seating charge) arrives as you sit. Fluffy dashimaki is the dish everyone mentions; then tempura, horse sashimi, smoked duck, meat udon. Regulars chat with the staff; diners like the late hours and fair prices for Gion. Smoking allowed; no strong perfume. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner at the counter (2023–2025 reviews); not named in a source
chef_bio.background: Tabelog describes a hidden Gion spot for seasonal dishes, obanzai and drinks, on the second floor of 第3万治ビル, three buildings north of the Kobu Kaburenjo theatre on Hanamikoji. chef_bio.philosophy: Tabelog introduction: a place to forget the rush of daily life over seasonal dishes and obanzai.

kyoto_gion_nanba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish kaiseki on dashi — conger eel, sweetfish, bonito, duck (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_nanba.hours_raw: Tabelog: lunch 12:00–13:30, dinner 17:30–20:00; closed Thursday; 2–4 January lunch from the ¥13,310 course. kyoto_gion_nanba.notes: [Kaiseki · Gion, a Michelin-starred alley house] A kaiseki house down a narrow alley off Shijo near Yasaka Shrine, with a six-seat counter, tables upstairs and kotatsu private rooms. Diners in 2026 praise the dashi, summer hamo and early matsutake, and lunch from ¥9,680 for a Michelin-starred house; the owner, proprietress and staff chat through the meal.
